faqs.q: Does the Axis Bank Privilege Visa Credit Card offer international lounge access?
faqs.a: No, the Axis Bank Privilege Credit Card doesn’t offer international lounge access. The lounge benefits are limited to domestic airport lounges only.

faqs.q: What all transactions are excluded from milestone benefits on Axis Bank Privilege Visa Credit Card?
faqs.a: Transactions such as fuel, rent, utilities, wallet reloads, insurance, and government payments are typically excluded from milestone spend calculations.

faqs.q: I want to check my spending milestone progress on Axis Bank Privilege Visa Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can check your spending milestone progress for your Axis Bank Privilege Credit Card via the Axis Bank mobile app or internet banking portal.

faqs.q: I want to apply for Axis Bank Privilege Credit Card, do I need an existing Axis Bank to apply for the card?
faqs.a: No, you don’t need an Axis Bank account to apply for Axis Bank Privilege Credit Card. You can directly apply for the card on the Axis Bank’s website. When asked if you are an existing bank customer, simply select “No”.

faqs.q: Is Axis Bank Privilege Visa Credit Card suitable for beginners?
faqs.a: Axis Bank Privilege Visa Credit Card is best suited for salaried individuals having moderate to high spending because the card’s benefits are maximised through higher annual spends. If you are a beginner and the benefits on Axis Privilege Credit Card align with your spending habits, you can consider applying for it.
